GD+ Proposal · 03 01 — Executive Summary

One build, five connected systems.

This proposal covers a complete digital foundation for GD+: a 20-page custom WordPress site, a blog your team can run independently, marketing automation that turns enquiries into relationships, and the SEO groundwork to be found in the first place — backed by three months of hands-on support after launch.

20

Pages, fully built

Custom Elementor/WordPress build, responsive across desktop, tablet and mobile, on your brand guidelines throughout.

1

Blog system, self-served

List and single-post templates plus a written publishing protocol, so your team can post without calling us every time.

2

Systems wired together

Website enquiry forms feed straight into Mailchimp, with automation flows doing the follow-up for you.

3

Months of support

10 hours/month post-launch — bug fixes, content tweaks and flow adjustments as real usage surfaces new needs.

GD+ Proposal · 04 02 — Scope of Work

Website Development & Blog System.

Website Development

  • 22-page custom website build (Elementor/WordPress)
  • Responsive design across desktop, tablet, mobile
  • Brand guidelines applied sitewide — colours, typography, imagery treatment
  • Sitemap and information architecture
  • Homepage wireframe + mockup for approval before build
  • Contact/enquiry forms wired to backend

Blog System & Template Builder

  • Blog template design — list view and single post view
  • Reusable Blog Template Builder — a pre-styled Elementor template so new posts are published by filling in a form, not rebuilding a layout
  • Category/tag structure setup
  • Publishing protocol document — step-by-step guide for posting, featured images, SEO fields, and more
GD+ Proposal · 05 02 — Scope of Work (continued)

Marketing Automation, SEO & Support.

Marketing Automation

  • Mailchimp account setup and list structure
  • Automation flows — e.g. enquiry → welcome sequence, or equivalent based on your brief
  • Data flow mapping between website forms and Mailchimp

SEO Foundation

  • On-page SEO setup — meta titles, descriptions, header structure
  • XML sitemap + robots.txt
  • Basic technical SEO checklist — page speed, alt tags, schema where relevant

Support

  • 3 months post-launch support, 10 hours/month — bug fixes, minor content updates, marketing flow adjustments
GD+ Proposal · 06 03 — Sitemap

22 pages, grouped into four systems.

The information architecture below covers company (including sector landing pages for corporates and associations), services, work & insights, and contact/utility — confirmed with you before design begins.

Company

  1. Home
  2. About
  3. Our Team
  4. Careers
  5. For Corporates
  6. For Associations

Services

  1. Services (Overview)
  2. Brand Communications
  3. Event Production
  4. Brand Activations
  5. Content Studio
  6. Digital Experiences
  7. Strategy & Planning

Work & Insights

  1. Case Studies (Archive)
  2. Case Study (Template)
  3. Blog (Archive)
  4. Blog Post (Template)

Contact & Utility

  1. Contact
  2. FAQs
  3. Privacy Policy
  4. Terms of Service
  5. Thank You (Confirmation)

Case Study and Blog Post are reusable WordPress templates, not individual pages — each new entry uses the same template, so the page count stays fixed as content grows. "For Corporates" and "For Associations" are dedicated sector landing pages, reflecting how GD+ already segments its audience across the live preview site.
